pathAssistantSteps.info:
Close the stage at any point during the process when the customer withdraws or purchases from an alternative supplier.

Remember, an Opportunity is for a particular reline: if we miss that reline the Opportunity is lost. If you believe the customer may still be interested in sourcing from ME Elecmetal then a new Opportunity for a future reline should be created.
Close the stage when the product is shipped and invoice is raised.

Identify next best alternative pricing.

Identify additional value that ME Elecmetal offers to determine potential pricing.

Identify potential pricing method: would the customer prefer a risk sharing model eg $ per week or $ per tonne processed ore.

Prepare proposal on on trial pricing (and long term pricing) and pricing method.

Get sign off from MD, ME Elecmetal APAC

Always accompany a commercial proposal with a meeting or phone call.

Close the stage when the commercial proposal is presented to the customer

Refine technical proposal based on customer feedback (full ECO).

If it is a part mill trial we may just have to copy the existing design.

Close the stage when the technical solution is agreed with the customer.

Using the information gleaned from the site visit, raise an Engineering Change Order (ECO) to create a proposed technical solution (use the truncated ECO process at this stage).

Strike while the iron is hot; respond within a week ... and if the proposal cannot be prepared in that time contact the customer with an update.

Close the stage when the first technical solution is presented to the customer.

Raise a House Order Form (HOF) based on the PO.

Ensure the foundry inform you of the outcome from the first article trial.

Keep track of progress through manufacturing process (a production meeting with China is held every Friday at 11am AEST.

Keep the customer informed of progress.

Ensure the invoice is in line with the PO to ensure on time payment.

Close the stage when the product is shipped and invoice is raised.

(Remember to open a new Opportunity for the replacement liners)

Ask for the Purchase Order (PO).

Revisit technical and / or commercial proposal is required.

Close the stage when the PO is received.

Use knowledge of the site to identify value adding Opportunities.

Write it down so it is easily understood.

Discuss with the customer before progressing too far.

Close stage when the customer confirms the idea has merit and they will consider it.
